title: Laura Zizzo (Estian Partners): 'we are implementing the thinking in how we are building Estian'
summary: Zizzo is co-founder and CEO of Estian Partners, which works in infrastructure investment and climate finance. She replied to Cordell Jacks, who had recommended the book to her.
blockquote: It clarified a lot for me and we are implementing the thinking in how we are building Estian too. I also highly recommend.
